_note: Servo settings that match what the HD-1910 simulation assumes: position mode, no deadband, no firmware acceleration profile, full duty (max_torque 980 = max_pwm 0.98), P gain set from the gain map, no D or I (the sim's servo law is pure proportional duty; the bench D-term check decides whether D=0 is right). goal_speed (46) and goal_current (44) are NOT written: their meaning in HLS position mode (speed cap? torque cap? 0 = unlimited or zero?) is unconfirmed; the configure script prints them so the first session can record what the factory left there.
